course.name: 인제 B코스 · 2018 SDC R1
course.description: 실대회 B코스 서쪽 헤어핀·방향 전환 재구성 · 공식 채점선 미확인
course.source: MOTION 행사 공지 + 참가팀 경기 원본 영상 + OpenStreetMap

event.direction: B-course western hairpin, mapped normal direction

presentation.geometry: 2018 SDC 1전 B코스 경기 영상의 서쪽 헤어핀과 다음 방향 전환을 OSM 중심선에 맞춘 재구성입니다. 시작·종료선, 폭 14m 및 채점 목표는 모형 설정이며 공식 클립 좌표가 아닙니다.
presentation.elevation: GLO-90 지표면 고도를 90m 거리 기준으로 평활화했습니다. 도로 측량값·캠버·주변 사면의 정확한 높이가 아닙니다.
presentation.environment: 경기 원본에서 적백 연석, 녹색 가장자리 페인트, 잔디와 금속 방호 경계를 확인했습니다. 지도 건물·잔디·수목 영역을 단순화했으며 수종·개별 나무·높이는 미확인입니다.

videoEvidence.observed: Original 720p frames: B-course queue and outer hairpin; red/white kerbs, green painted edge strip, asphalt, grass island, silver guardrails, red/white safety barriers, wooded hillside. Species, dimensions and exact event scoring points not established.
videoEvidence.inspection: selected original frames only; not a claim to have watched full video

videoEvidence.observed: Original participant qualification clip sampled every 5 seconds: repeated approach, broad hairpin and next transition by B paddock; route matched to current OSM western B-course bend sequence. Extracted clip uses keyframe seeking, so labels are approximate.
videoEvidence.inspection: selected original frames only; not a claim to have watched full video

limitations: No official georeferenced start, finish or clipping-zone plan recovered.
Map-to-video matching establishes a plausible physical bend sequence, not a surveyed event layout.
Constant 14m corridor is estimated; runoff, kerb height, friction and crossfall are unmeasured.
90m DSM post-dates the events and can include vegetation/buildings; surrounding terrain is not a detailed topographic reconstruction.
Current OSM features may have changed since the event; temporary tents, signs and sponsor artwork are omitted.
